text:
sam: quick sync - startup wants a 6-week Dedicated POC, commit of 8 GPUs (4xA10G + 4xA100). asking for a friendly blended price and a reduced burst multiplier for the POC. any objections?
rita: can do but need numbers. how much burst are they asking for?
sam: they asked to allow up to 15% of committed hours as burst and asked if multiplier can be 1.6 for the 6 weeks.
paul: finance flag: anything that drops effective unit rev >10% needs deal-desk approval. also H100/H100-adjacent carveouts trigger legal; here it's A100 so simpler but still check min price.
ops-engr: FYI autoscale spin-up billing starts after 60s in this pool. burst billed per-minute thereafter. ops cost delta: A10G infra cost ~$0.40/hr, A100 infra cost ~$1.20/hr (internal).
rita: do a quick blended calc and post it, i'll draft the deal note.
sam: calc pasted: ```
base A10G = $1.00/hr, A100 = $2.40/hr
weighted_base = (4*1.00 + 4*2.40)/8 = (4 + 9.6)/8 = 13.6/8 = $1.70/hr per GPU
commit hours (6-week month equivalent) = 6 * 720 / 4? wait - use monthly baseline 720 hrs for a 4-week month, scaled for 6 weeks we use 6*168=1008 hours per week? simpler: use monthly view to compare.
use monthly hours=720 for quoting simplicity.
base_monthly = 8 * 720 * 1.70 = $9,792
burst cap = 15% of commit hours = 0.15 * 720 = 108 GPU-hours per GPU
burst_multiplier = 1.6
burst_cost_max = 8 * 108 * 1.70 * 1.6 = $2,371.04
worst-case monthly = $9,792 + $2,371 = $12,163
```
paul: with infra costs that looks OK if we keep commit discount <10%. if you give >10% on commit AND 1.6x burst we need deal-desk escalation.
sam: propose: 8 GPUs for 6 weeks, blended commit rate = weighted_base minus 8% introductory discount => $1.564/hr, burst 15% at 1.6x for POC only, capped, auto-rev to list after POC.
rita: good. i'll draft: "POC: 6 weeks. Commit: 8 GPUs (4xA10G + 4xA100). Blended commit rate $1.56/hr (8% intro). Burst up to 15% hours, multiplier 1.6x for duration. Post-POC rates revert to list. Autoscale billing after 60s. Deal Desk review required for >10% effective discount."
paul: please include justification (startup proof-of-concept, likely commit conversion) in the form.
deal-desk-bot: Deal submission link: https://internal.redwood/deals/submit/1749999999 54a - status: awaiting triage.
sam: thanks all, i'll attach the customer's LOI and ping when deal-desk responds. :rocket:
